summary: round 3, delta since 32d4ef6: F-24, F-25, F-26, F-28, F-29, F-30 fixed (a73739e: component view SPA x 240 to 140 and e1 label x=-0.2, e16d x=-0.35; boxes widened with 8 px padding, no ADR id or N = 0 breaks; error view e1 dashed, relabelled, legend and README L36-L37; signup L2 names SessionService; fontSize=12 on every cell). export --check passes; all 10 PNGs viewed: no overlaps, labels over shapes, unhopped crossings, clipping or cut-off content; legends present. PDFs not viewed this round (no renderer, F-32). Follow-ups: 2 minor (F-27 carried, F-33 new), 2 info (F-31 carried, F-32 new). Totals: 0 blocker, 0 major, 2 minor, 2 info.

findings.message: Requested export settings are not met: PNGs have no border on the right and bottom (content ends within a few pixels of the image edge, for example the SQLite cylinder in c4-component-api.png, Controllers and services in c4-component-errors.png, the cross-origin note in seq-signup-login.png, the SQLite participant in seq-clear-completed.png and seq-todo-crud-list.png, the system boundary in c4-container.png), and PDFs are cropped to content rather than fit-to-page (README L9-L10). Nothing is cut off. harness docs diagram export takes only paths and --check, so the author cannot set a border or fit-to-page; this is a platform gap.
findings.suggestion: Ask the platform team to add border and fit-to-page options to harness docs diagram export; until then, optionally keep at least 40 px of empty canvas right of and below the last shape so the crop leaves a margin.

findings.message: SecurityConfig is described as registering RequestIdFilter. sdd 10 L579-L581 says a FilterRegistrationBean in config registers it ahead of the security chain, without naming the class; the label is a reasonable reading but more specific than the spec.
findings.suggestion: Optionally reword to: config registers RequestIdFilter (FilterRegistrationBean, sdd 10).

findings.message: The ten re-exported PDFs in pdf/ were not visually checked in round 3: the PDF renderer (pdftoppm) is not installed in the review environment. harness docs diagram export --check confirms they were regenerated from the current sources, and the matching PNGs render cleanly, but PDF rendering itself is unverified this round.
findings.suggestion: Open the PDFs once (or install poppler for the reviewer) before the PR to confirm they match the PNGs.

findings.message: README L13 now says 8 px text padding is a layout rule applied to every diagram, but the padding was added only to component, screen and lifeline boxes. c4-context.drawio (user: no spacing; todo, none: 10), c4-container.drawio (user: none; spa, proxy, api: 10), deployment-local.drawio (browser, vite, jvm, file, env: none), data-model.drawio tables (10) and the sequence notes (6) use other values, so the stated rule is inaccurate.
findings.suggestion: Reword to what was applied (for example: at least 6-10 px text padding on boxes that hold wrapped text), or add spacingLeft=8;spacingRight=8 to the remaining boxes and re-export.
